name: @quarry/data-connection-worker
description: Runs syncs and source probes: the only process that reaches source systems and resolves their credentials. NestJS app (BullMQ processors + GET /health). No database access — talks to the server's /internal API.

scripts.dev: nodemon -w src -w ../shared -w ../integrations -e ts,json --exec ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/main.ts
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json
